Pleased we went for the overall experience but wouldn’t rush here for the food.

Date time with honey
Apr 2026 • Couples
We had a lovely time at Lim. The food was good and portions are smaller/more gourmet style. My food was not great (ok though) but my husbands was delicious, do I'd give the food 5 star hit or miss. BUT, for the price - VERY expensive for vietnam and just honestly some of it felt overpriced even to our USD - I would expect everything to be on spot, you know? Service was professional and dessert was fine (again, nothing extraordinary but tasty and gine). The environment is awesome. It did feel romantic (we were on the top floor and reserved) and roomy. I think sitting outside could be nice if the weather is good in the evening but it may be louder. I also had wine and appreciated the selection.

A clear recommendation
Mar 2026 • Couples
This restaurant is sensational in every way: The fantastic house, the tasteful and minimalist decor and of course the excellent food. We really like Vietnamese cuisine, but for a longer stay we crave Italian cuisine. We had a caprese and then gnocchi, spaghetti and maccheroni. Everything homemade and of the very best quality. We wished to have such a good Italian with us in Switzerland. The service was extremely friendly and accommodating. Prices are very fair. A clear recommendation.
